plan.title: Frontier-Evidence Intake + Autopilot
plan.goal: Fold current + frontier AI research into our system by default: a pull-model context provider wired into every PRD/plan/review/session, backed by a verified, deduped, source-scored backlog and a concept taxonomy that both ranks relevance (focus on the core) and guarantees coverage (all relevant subjects). No polling; fresh at the point of use; every adopt passes a benchmark gate.
success_criteria: Creating a PRD/plan or starting a session automatically surfaces our verified frontier verdicts for the subject — agents never re-chase what we measured/dropped or corrected
Every candidate is primary-source-verified, mapped to an AQ-OS measurement, and adopted only after a baseline-before/after benchmark on our hardware
Coverage gaps (subjects with no source or candidate) are visible and turned into targeted, need-driven research — not a blanket timer
Source quality is measured (adopt-rate) so low-signal sources are pruned and high-signal ones prioritized

phases.name: FA — Autopilot infrastructure (the loop)
phases.goal: backlog, catalog, relevance, coverage, on-demand context, seam wiring, auto-fold, refresh, parity backstop

phases.name: FE — Verified candidates (adopt via benchmark gate)
phases.goal: evidence-backed techniques mapped to AQ-OS slices with acceptance goals

items.name: backlog + aq-frontier CLI
items.goal: durable append-only deduped candidate store + CLI (add/list/digest/status/seed)
items.validation_goal: test-frontier-backlog 5/5; dedup by content hash; fail-safe reads

items.name: source catalog + quality metrics
items.goal: 27-source curated catalog across 5 pillars + adopt-rate/coverage metrics
items.validation_goal: test-frontier-sources 5/5; every pillar has a primary source
items.editorial_note: assess/refine which sources earn their place (0867a06e)

items.name: relevance + concept coverage
items.goal: hybrid keyword-taxonomy + live vector-DB relevance; coverage gaps

items.name: on-demand context + seam wiring
items.goal: aq-frontier context provider (pull, not poll) + wired into create-prd/plan-feature/session-start
items.validation_goal: test-frontier-context 5/5; session-start shows frontier block live
items.editorial_note: frontier research incorporated by default into every workflow

items.name: auto-fold approved -> plan trackers
items.goal: an approved backlog candidate auto-appends as a slice to its target plan tracker; tier0 check binds scheduled candidates to real slices
items.validation_goal: approved FE item appears as a projected slice; fail-closed on orphan

items.name: on-demand scan-topic refresh
items.goal: targeted single-topic web-verify routed to a web-capable lane when a queried topic is stale/gap (need-driven, not a timer)
items.validation_goal: a stale topic triggers a bounded scan that appends verified candidates
items.editorial_note: the lazy refresh behind the pull model

items.name: parity sweep backstop
items.goal: low-frequency reverse check for never-queried concepts -> emits gaps; the ONLY remaining timer, a safety net
items.validation_goal: emits a gap for a deliberately-untracked concept
items.editorial_note: safety net, not the access path

items.name: PRM-as-verify signal (local agent)
items.goal: use aq-qa/behavioral-verify as a process-reward signal so the local loop prefers a verified branch pre-commit
items.validation_goal: measured pass-rate lift on the dogfood set, no APU latency blow-up
items.editorial_note: FE-1 approved; target plan: local-agent harness; benchmark-first

items.name: GEPA build-time prompt compile
items.goal: FE-2a functional eval metric (baseline was a ceilinged self-probe), then FE-2b GEPA offline compile gated by aq-qa
items.validation_goal: compiled local-agent prompt beats the FE-2a functional baseline + tier0

items.name: Landlock/eBPF egress pin
items.goal: runtime LSM/eBPF egress + cgroup pin for untrusted MCP servers (loopback-only)
items.validation_goal: deny-closed egress proof + no tool regression; attach to Foundation-C activation evidence
items.editorial_note: FE-8 approved; target plan: aqos-foundation-c (surfaced there via the context seam)
